visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two women stand under an outdoor colonnade. The woman on the left has long black hair, a tanned complexion, and wears a pink spaghetti strap top. The woman on the right has brown hair with bangs and a floral patterned white top. They look at the camera and each other, speaking with active facial expressions. In the background, there is a paved area with pillars, green trees, and distant figures. (2) The scene continues as the man in a white t-shirt and dark sunglasses enters the background behind the women. He holds a white beverage cup and listens while looking at the camera. The women continue to gesture with their hands while talking, occasionally looking towards the man. The lighting is bright natural daylight coming from the side. (3) The camera alternates between medium shots of the group and individual close-ups. The woman on the right touches her hair and laughs. The man steps forward between them, engaging in the conversation. Yellow and white variety-style text overlays appear at the bottom and top of the frame. The background remains consistent with the outdoor school-like or park environment.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, medium-tempo synth-pop BGM starts immediately with a strong electronic beat. Two female voices engage in fast-paced conversation with high pitch and enthusiastic energy. A light 'ding' sound effect emphasizes a text reveal. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect triggers as the conversation shifts. The male voice enters with a moderate pitch and humorous, teasing delivery style. The BGM remains constant under the dialogue. (3) Laughter from all speakers overlaps with the music. Short, comedic cartoon sound effects (a slide whistle and a 'pop') occur during the banter about spending money. The vocal intensity remains high with frequent peaks during outbursts of laughter.
